summary: Added a pure, provider-neutral task-state policy primitive for AUTOPILOT-004. It defines legal task transitions, dependency/attempt claim gates, independent-verification requirements for runtime-changing completion, and human-approval requirements for higher-authority risk classes. No dispatcher, network adapter, model call, lease persistence, or runtime activation was added.

claims.claim: The new module is a pure policy primitive and performs no external or runtime actions.

checks.name: static_review
checks.details: Module contains only constants, dataclasses, and pure validation functions.

checks.name: test_execution
checks.details: GitHub connector can write repository files but this run did not execute repository tests.

uncertainties: Persistent lease semantics and provider adapter contracts remain to be implemented.
Tests require independent execution/CI before this partial task can advance beyond implementation evidence.
risks: State-policy semantics may need refinement after the canonical Guardian runtime is reconciled.

next_recommendation.task_objective: Execute and review the task-state tests independently, then identify the smallest persistent ledger/lease primitive that can be added without activating runtime workers.
